subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Carbon Offsets
description: A short lesson to help you apply Carbon Offsets.

hook.text: A company pays to plant trees to 'offset' its shipping emissions. But the trees take 20 years to absorb the CO₂.

buildup.text: Carbon offsets fund projects that reduce or remove emissions elsewhere to compensate for your own.

discovery.text: Types include tree planting, renewable energy, methane capture, and direct air carbon capture.

twist.text: Many offset projects are low-quality or unverifiable. Some forests counted as offsets were already protected.

climax.text: Credible offsets use verified standards like Gold Standard or Verra. But reducing emissions beats offsetting.

punchline.text: Offsets are a bridge, not a destination. Reduce first.

quiz.question: What is the problem with many carbon offset projects?
